steps.title: Harvest and embed TA muscles
steps.instruction: Euthanize mice according to approved protocol, surgically harvest both tibialis anterior (TA) muscles, add OCT to the cryomold edge avoiding bubbles (remove bubbles with a 200 µL pipette if formed), and embed each TA in OCT using tweezers.

steps.title: Freeze tissue blocks and section
steps.instruction: Place a 2 L beaker containing 300 mL 2‑methylbutane into an ice bucket with liquid nitrogen (LN₂ level higher than the 2‑methylbutane). Using extra‑long forceps, lower the cryomold into the chilled 2‑methylbutane for 45 s, then immediately transfer the cryomold to dry ice and store the block at –80 °C. Cut 12 µm sections on a cryostat (e.g., Leica 1860 UV), mount on Superfrost Plus slides, and keep slides in a sealed box at –80 °C until use.

steps.title: Prepare reagents and equipment
steps.instruction: Chill 4 % PFA in 1× PBS at 4 °C for 1 h. Prepare 2 L of 1× wash buffer (dilute 50× RNAscope wash buffer with ddH₂O; warm the 50× stock to 40 °C for 10–20 min before dilution). Set the HybEZ™ II oven to 40 °C and place tissue paper in the humidity tray, adding 100 mL ddH₂O to dampen and removing excess water. Bring H₂O₂, Protease IV, RNAscope amplification reagents (AMP 1‑3) and HRP reagents (HRP‑C1, HRP‑C3, HRP blocker) to room temperature. Warm RNAscope probes (Pax7, positive control UBC, negative control dapB) at 40 °C for 10 min. Prepare control slides: one with UBC probe (positive), one with dapB probe (negative), and one fluorophore‑only negative control.

steps.title: Fix slides and PBS washes
steps.instruction: Remove slides from –80 °C and fix in 100 mL 4 % PFA in 1× PBS for 1 h at 4 °C. Transfer slides to two jars each containing 100 mL 1× PBS; in each jar, move the slide rack up‑and‑down for 2 min to rinse, then repeat with the second jar.

steps.title: Dehydrate tissue sections
steps.instruction: Fill four slide staining jars with 100 mL each of 50 % alcohol, 70 % alcohol, 100 % alcohol, and a second 100 % alcohol (histology‑grade). Incubate slides in 50 % alcohol for 5 min at room temperature, then sequentially repeat with 70 %, 100 %, and a second 100 % (5 min each).

steps.title: Draw hydrophobic barrier
steps.instruction: Air‑dry slides for 5 min on a Kimwipe at room temperature with sections facing up. Using an ImmEdge™ hydrophobic barrier pen, draw a barrier around each tissue section, retracing the line three additional times; air‑dry 1 min at room temperature.

steps.title: H2O2 pretreatment
steps.instruction: Place slides on the EZ‑Batch™ holder, add five drops of H₂O₂ to fully cover each section, incubate 10 min at room temperature in the humidity tray, then wash once with 1× PBS.

steps.title: Protease IV pretreatment
steps.instruction: Add five drops of Protease IV to each section, incubate 15 min at room temperature in the humidity tray, then wash with 1× PBS.

steps.title: Probe hybridization
steps.instruction: Add five drops of the appropriate RNAscope probe (Pax7, UBC, or dapB) to each section, ensure complete coverage, and incubate in the HybEZ™ II oven at 40 °C for 2 h. Remove the tray and wash with 1× wash buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add five drops of AMP 1, incubate 30 min at 40 °C, then wash with 1× wash buffer.
Add five drops of AMP 2, incubate 30 min at 40 °C, then wash with 1× wash buffer.
Add five drops of AMP 3, incubate 15 min at 40 °C, then wash with 1× wash buffer.
Add five drops of HRP‑C1 and HRP‑C3, incubate 15 min at 40 °C, then wash with 1× wash buffer.
Add five drops of TSA Vivid Fluorophore 650 (1:1,500 dilution per Recipe 5), incubate 30 min at 40 °C, then wash with 1× wash buffer.
Add five drops of HRP‑blocker, incubate 15 min at 40 °C, then wash with 1× wash buffer.
Wash slides in PBST at room temperature for 5 min, repeat 4 times.
Apply 150 µL of 10 % M.O.M. in PBST to each section, incubate 30 min at room temperature.
Apply 150 µL of blocking buffer containing 1 % M.O.M., incubate 1.5 h at room temperature.
Apply 150 µL of primary anti‑PAX7 antibody (1:2 dilution in blocking buffer), incubate overnight (12–16 h) at 4 °C.
Wash slides in PBST at room temperature for 15 min, repeat 4 times.
Apply 150 µL of Alexa Fluor 555 secondary antibody (1:500 dilution in blocking buffer), incubate 45 min at room temperature.
Wash PBST 15 min ×4; during the third wash add Hoechst solution (1 µg/mL).
Mount each slide with 25 µL Vectashield mounting medium.
Place a coverslip, seal all edges with clear nail polish three times, and dry 5 min at room temperature.
Store slides at 4 °C protected from light for up to 1 week.
Use a Zeiss LSM 800 Axio Imager.Z2 upright confocal microscope; set magnification to 20× for quantification or 63× for representative images.
Adjust master gain, laser power, and acquisition parameters (averaging, bits/pixel, scan speed, frame size, etc.) ensuring no signal in control slides and keep settings constant for all images.
Acquire Z‑stacks every 1.5 µm, collecting 8–10 stacks per image.
Generate orthogonal projections using the ZEN software processing feature.
